elements.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 27.2 expressly provides that the Agreement is governed by and construed under New York law.

elements.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 27.2 grants the state and federal courts located in New York County exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute, which includes the merits. No other-court carve-out is included, so there is no exception broader than the permitted temporary-injunctive-relief exception.

elements.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The clause selects New York law, not Delaware, California, or England and Wales law.

elements.element: The dispute forum is the corresponding Delaware or California courts, or the courts of London for England and Wales law.
elements.evidence: The clause selects state and federal courts in New York County rather than a permitted fallback forum.
